launch.title: From factory to shelf, one stage at a time.
launch.sub: Seven stages, each with a clear scope, timeline and written result. Join where you are, stop after any stage, and know the cost before it starts.

stages.name: Research
stages.scope: Shelf and price survey in the target cities, competitor map, product fit.
stages.deliverable: A go / no-go report and the recommended entry route

stages.name: Scout
stages.scope: Your team on the ground with ours: retail clusters, distributors, regulators.
stages.deliverable: Introductions, a debrief and a next-step plan

stages.name: Samples in market
stages.scope: Samples in front of real buyers, with their answers unedited — including the ones you will not like.
stages.deliverable: A buyer feedback report with prices they would pay

stages.name: Set up
stages.scope: Local entity, customs and tax, certification — run in parallel, not in sequence.
stages.deliverable: A company that can import, and the approvals to sell

stages.name: Trial container
stages.scope: One container or less, priced properly, sold through our channel.
stages.deliverable: True landed cost, sell-through and return rate — before anyone commits

stages.name: Territory or TGO brand
stages.scope: A territory agreement in plain language — or we build and own a brand that you manufacture.
stages.deliverable: Volume bands, exclusivity where earned, warranty terms, marketing split

stages.name: Scale
stages.scope: More markets, more channels, a wider range, and a senior operator if you want one.
stages.deliverable: A growth plan with targets, reviewed every quarter

launch.forTitle: Who it is for — and who it is not.

items: Manufacturers and brand owners with a product that already sells somewhere
Capacity for at least one trial container
Ready to stand behind a warranty in the market
Willing to adapt packaging, specs or price for the market
Products that cannot be certified for the market
Looking for an agent's commission rather than a partner
No product yet — start with Research on its own

launch.pricingTitle: Fixed fees to start. A share of what sells after.

pricing.d: Research, scout trips, samples in market and set-up are quoted per stage before they start. You can stop after any of them.
From the trial container on, we earn a margin or a share of revenue on what sells through our channel. When you do not sell, we do not earn.

faq.a: Each of the first four stages is quoted upfront after a first conversation, based on your product and markets. From the trial container we move to a margin or revenue share.

faq.q: Do I have to do every stage?
faq.a: No. Join where you are — some partners arrive with certification done and start at the trial container. You can also stop after any stage.
Your choice. Your own brand under a territory agreement, or a TGO-owned brand that you manufacture for us.

faq.q: How long until the first sales?
faq.a: Typically three to six months from research to the first container on shelves. Markets that require product registration take longer, because it has to come first.

faq.q: What do I see along the way?
faq.a: Every stage ends with a written result. Partners also get a portal with their stage, certification clock, shipments and sell-through — see the preview.

launch.applyNote: A few questions, about two minutes. A person replies within two working days.
